name: Special Meeting of the Lomita City Council-Strategic Planning Workshop
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Wednesday, March 05, 2014 - 04:00 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a 5 minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
4.
MID-YEAR BUDGET REVIEW Presentation of Mid-Year Budget Review for Fiscal Year 2013/2014.
Presented by Administrative Services Director Chavez
SM Staff Report 4
5.
PROPOSED REORGANIZATION OF CITY DEPARTMENTS
a.
Upon the retirement of Community Services Director McPherron reassign the remaining two staff members of the Department to the Community Development Department (Community Services Analyst) and the City Manager's Department (Administrative Clerk II) and delete the Community Services Director (FTE) position
b.
Approve an Assistant Engineer (FTE) position in the Public Works Department and delete three part-time Maintenance Worker positions and one contract position
c.
Create a Management Analyst (FTE) position in the Administrative Services Department/City Manager's Department and delete one FTE position (Administrative Clerk)
d.
Create one additional Recreation Supervisor (FTE) position in the Parks and Recreation Department and delete one Recreation Coordinator (FTE) position in the Parks and Recreation Department
e.
Create a City Clerk (FTE) position in the City Manager's Department and delete the Assistant City Clerk (FTE) position in the City Manager's Department
Presented by City Manager Rock
SM Staff report 5
6.
ISSUE PAPERS
a.
Reestablishment of a Replacement Fund for Equipment and Facilities -
Presented by City Manager Rock
b.
Master Fee Study -
Presented by Administrative Services Director Chavez
c.
Discussion Regarding the Possible Use of Quimby Funds (Playground Equipment) -
Presented by Parks and Recreation Director Harding
SM Staff report 6
7.
ADJOURNMENT
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
